data.outcome_summary: This OECD TALIS 2024: Iceland note summarizes teacher and principal questionnaire results collected in 2024 for lower secondary education in Iceland. TALIS is based on self-reports, so the indicators reflect teachers’ and principals’ perceptions and confidence, which may vary by social and cultural context; the note therefore advises caution for cross-country comparisons. The note reports descriptive percentages (e.g., teacher age distribution, gender composition, experience, perceived ability to adapt teaching to diversity, special education needs context, social and emotional learning confidence, and technology/AI use) and highlights only statistically significant differences or changes relative to the OECD average. Some estimates are marked as higher risk of non-response bias, indicating that uncertainty may be larger for those indicators. No student achievement outcomes, plausible values, or ML prediction models are used in this note; it is intended for policy interpretation of survey-based patterns rather than causal inference.
